svg.text: Same firmware as the robot · lap 1 maps the field at 35 cm/s · laps 2–3 follow the line the car computed · then it parks
green band = Intelligent Trajectory is driving
it builds the map of the field.
From lap 2 it trusts that map and
brakes only where a pillar or wall
Generated by docs/tools/make_readme_assets.py from simulator data · red pillar → pass on the right · green → left · magenta = parking bay limiters
